updates.title: Market Update
updates.content: The S&P 500 continues to test new highs, but technical indicators suggest a lack of conviction, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average has gained 8.9% in the first half of 2026, its best performance since 2021.

updates.title: Current Developments
updates.content: The presidential debate has thrown huge uncertainty in the American economy and U.S.'s international standing, while economists have become good at predicting the Fed's favorite inflation gauge PCE, with headline PCE coming in at 0.0% and core PCE at 0.1%.

updates.title: Market Reactions
updates.content: Oil prices have surged to a 3-month high, driven by seasonal demand and supply issues related to geopolitical tensions and hurricanes, while the stock market's attempt to break to a new high has been met with low volume, indicating a lack of conviction.

updates.title: Portfolio Strategy
updates.content: A diversified long-term investor should consider waiting for the air to clear post-debate and focus on mega cap stocks, fossil fuel energy stocks, and the Magnificent Seven stocks, which are expected to be winners post-debate.

updates.title: Looking Ahead
updates.content: Next week, investors should watch for changes in the portfolios and be prepared for potential shifts in the market due to the ongoing presidential debate and its impact on the American economy and U.S.'s international standing.
